comments.body:
@pcbeingused333 Thanks, good one. Will review this weekend. Ping if not.

I might put this in "next reelease" v0.8.0, not sure yet.
Hi @jeremychone, following up as you suggested: is there anything you'd like changed here, or anything else needed from my side?

@pcbeingused333 Ho, I got confused, I thought this was an API change, but it's not. 

let me merge it soon.

PR Commit message:

```
EmbedOptions::with_encoding_format("base64") makes the OpenAI API return
each embedding as a base64 string of little-endian f32 bytes. The adapter
deserialized the field as Vec<f32> only, so the response failed with a
StreamParse error. Accept both shapes and decode the base64 one.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```
@pcbeingused333 all good. Sorry for the confusion. v0.7.3 coming today.
